text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolve] Purple Lv.4 + red Lv.4: Cost 0 Stack the 2 specified Digimon and digivolve unsuspended.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Raid＞ ＜Partition (purple Lv.4 & red Lv.4)＞ [When Digivolving] If DNA digivolving, you may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Free] trait from your trash without paying the cost. Then, 1 of your Digimon may gain ＜Rush＞ for the turn and attack a player.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Partition (purple Lv.4 & red Lv.4)＞ (When this Digimon with each of the specified digivolution cards would leave the battle area other than by your effects or a battle, you may play 1 each of the specified cards without paying the costs.)
